state.pending: Pair your Codie in Settings to finish setup
state.not-paired: No Codie paired: open Settings to pair one
tray.update.login: Sign in to check for updates…
update.login-title: Sign in to get Codie Game Buddy updates
update.notify.ready: Version {version} is ready: pick "Restart to update" in the tray menu.
update.notify.latest: Codie Game Buddy {current} is up to date.
commentary.heading: Commentary
commentary.enabled: Let Codie comment on my games
commentary.chatty: Chatty mode: Codie keeps talking, one remark right after another
commentary.chatty-hint: Codie talks even when the scene has not changed, and never interrupts you talking to it. Each remark is one cloud image request, so it uses more than usual.
commentary.avoid-interrupting: Don't interrupt me while I'm talking to Codie
commentary.sample.before: Check the screen for changes every
commentary.sample.after: seconds (on this PC only, nothing is sent)
commentary.threshold.after: (1–64, worked out on this PC; higher = bigger change)
commentary.hotkey-hint: To have Codie comment right now, press {hotkey}.
advanced.heading: Advanced options
games.heading: Games
games.on: Comment on this game. Games of the same program (a browser, a launcher) stay on the list, one switched on at a time
games.empty: No games yet. Pick a running game below and click Add.
games.manual: Add a game by its program file:
commentary.guide-tips: Guide tips: when a boss, unit or card from the game's wiki is on screen, Codie may pass on a tip about it
commentary.guide-tips-hint: Tips come from the game's wiki (BWIKI in Chinese, Fandom or wiki.gg in English); only the names matched on screen are sent to it. A game without a wiki found gets none: paste its wiki address under the game.
games.read-counters: Read the numbers first: before a remark, read the resources on screen (food, wood, gold and the like)
games.read-counters-hint: For games that keep their resources on screen (real-time strategy, city builders): Codie does not call one resource by another's name. Each remark takes two requests to the model your Codie uses: about two seconds longer and about twice the model cost. On by default for strategy games, off for the others.
games.persona-placeholder: Character for Codie to play in this game (optional), e.g. Play Paimon: call yourself Paimon and call the player Traveler
games.guide-none: No guide wiki found: paste its address to get tips
language.heading: Language
device.heading: Codie device
device.none: No Codie found on this network.
device.paired-missing: · paired, not found on the network now
pair.code-format: Enter the 6 digits shown on the device screen.
pair.result.DEVICE_NOT_SCANNED: Scan again, then pick the device.
pair.result.NO_PAIRING_IN_PROGRESS: This pairing has ended. Press Pair again.
pair.result.DEVICE_UNREACHABLE: Codie did not answer. Check that it is on and on the same network as this computer.
pair.result.CREDENTIAL_NOT_ISSUED: This Codie's firmware is too old to pair. Update it, then pair again.
pair.result.DEVICE_NOT_SIGNED_IN: This Codie is not signed in to an account. Sign in on the device, then pair again.
pair.result.INVALID_CODE: Wrong code. Check the code on the device screen.
pair.result.PAIRING_CODE_EXPIRED: The code has expired. Press Pair to get a new one.
pair.result.PAIRING_CODE_USED: This code was already used. Press Pair to get a new one.
pair.result.PAIRING_SOURCE_MISMATCH: The code was requested from another computer. Press Pair again here.
pair.result.PAIRING_REQUEST_RATE_LIMITED: Too many pairing attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
pair.result.PAIRING_SOURCE_NOT_ALLOWED: Codie refused pairing from this computer.
pair.result.PAIRING_SESSION_CREATE_FAILE: Pairing failed on the device. Try again.
pair.result.LOCAL_SECRET_INIT_FAILED: Pairing failed on the device. Try again.
activity.no-game: Waiting for a listed game in front
activity.no-frame: {game}: cannot capture; try borderless window mode
activity.failed: Commentary failed; see the last error
activity.hotkey-received: Received. The latest frame will be captured when ready; repeated presses add no requests.
commentary.save-to-history-hint: Off by default. On, each comment stays in your chat with Codie (the screenshot and the request with it), so you can talk about it afterwards; it does not update memory or the diary.
commentary.fast-mode-hint: On by default: one model request per comment, skipping Read the numbers first and exact resource amounts. Turn off to use each game’s number-reading setting.
activity.window-changed: Foreground window changed; hotkey request cancelled
